summary: Frontend-only E2E verification of Little Legacy Learners™ PHASE 2 (Character Mastering) and PHASE 3 (Pilot Episode Manufacturing) at /little-legacy as Founder. All 7 tabs render (Overview, Universe Bible, Characters, Character Mastering, Stories, Pilot Studio, Governance). Pilot Studio shows the pre-rendered 720p pilot for TEST_Episode_Acceptance with video/mp4, captions .srt, 4 green governance gates and an ENABLED Approve button (NOT clicked, per instructions). Character Mastering starts a background job (toast + Generating spinner + button hides) on Nova Sparkle. Zero uncaught console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: LittleLegacyStudio.js is now ~519 lines with two large in-file components (MasteringTab, PilotTab). Still under the 700-line threshold, but for future extensibility consider extracting MasteringTab and PilotTab into their own files under src/pages/little-legacy/ — they each own polling timers and local state and would test independently.

PilotTab polls every 6s and MasteringTab every 5s. On unmount both properly clear intervals via useRef cleanup — good. However, if the user leaves the tab (Radix TabsContent still mounts children conditionally) polling may keep running unnecessarily. Consider gating polling on active tab if this becomes costly.

Approve button (ll-approve-pilot-*) is correctly disabled via `disabled={!p.governance_passed}`, so the Knowledge-First / governance guard is enforced at the UI layer in addition to the API layer. Good.

Verified-only manufacture gate: `verified = e.verification_status === 'Verified'` — the manufacture button and video only render when verified, and an amber 'Knowledge Required' chip + warning show otherwise. Correctly implemented (couldn't be exercised in this state — both current episode blueprints are Verified).
Video and image srcs use `${BACKEND}${p.video_url}` / `${BACKEND}${m.model_sheet_url}` — BACKEND is process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Correct, no hardcoding.

MasteringTab.startMaster optimistically sets status to 'RENDERING' before polling — good UX. If the POST fails after optimistic update, the local state would drift; the catch shows a toast but doesn't roll back the optimistic state. Minor UX concern, not a bug for the current flow.
seed_data_creation: Started ONE mastering background job for character 'nova-sparkle' (POST /api/little-legacy/characters/nova-sparkle/master). This is an async AI-image + TTS job (~1-2 min). The founder will see it complete in the Character Mastering tab shortly.
